title: Soft tissue cancers of the head and neck (other than salivary glands and thyroid)
summary: Head and neck cancer (other than salivary glands and thyroid) with one of: inoperable, unresectable, or recurrent disease (after initial therapy); regional lymph node metastases beyond the regional lymph nodes; distant metastases; small cell carcinoma; or persistence/recurrence after radiation therapy.

head and neck cancer: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

children.criterion: Pathology-confirmed head and neck cancer (other than salivary glands and thyroid)
One of the listed alternatives qualifies
Persistent or recurrent disease following initial anticancer therapy
Metastases beyond the regional lymph nodes
Small cell (oat cell) carcinoma at any anatomic site
Soft tissue cancer originating in the head and neck treated with multimodal anticancer therapy (chemoradiation), considered disabled for 18 months from initiation
